quote: Basic Metrics To provide a basic assessment of this generation task, we use well-established metrics commonly used in previous research, namely ROUGE, BLEU, and METEOR. ... Factuality Metrics ... we decompose output text into sentence-level facts, then take ground truth as knowledge source to calculate the percentages of entailment (NLI-E) and contradiction (NLI-C) sentences in outputs. We also compute the percentage of hallucinated tokens compared to both inputs and ground truths, named Halluc.
